description: This Java class 'LocalResourceManager' manages Android resource files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, providing methods to access resource directories, resource elements, attribute definitions, and resource lookup functionalities.

classes.name: LocalResourceManager
classes.description: Manages Android resource files within an IntelliJ IDEA plugin environment, providing resource access and lookup functionalities.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Retrieves the singleton instance of LocalResourceManager for a given Module or PsiElement.

methods.name: getAllResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns all resource directories associated with the AndroidFacet.

methods.name: isResourceDir
methods.description: Checks if a given VirtualFile is a resource directory.

methods.name: getResourceDirs
methods.description: Returns the list of resource directories.

methods.name: getResourceElements
methods.description: Returns resource elements with their associated VirtualFiles.

methods.name: getValueResources
methods.description: Retrieves value resources of a specific type.

methods.name: collectResourceDirs
methods.description: Recursively collects resource directories from a given AndroidFacet and its dependencies.

methods.name: getValueResourceTypes
methods.description: Returns the set of resource types available in value resources.

methods.name: getAttributeDefinitions
methods.description: Returns attribute definitions, loading and caching them if necessary.

methods.name: findAttrs
methods.description: Finds attributes by name across resources.

methods.name: findStyleableAttributesByFieldName
methods.description: Finds styleable attributes based on a field name pattern.

methods.name: findResourcesByField
methods.description: Finds resource elements associated with a given PsiField.

methods.name: findResourcesByFieldName
methods.description: Finds resource elements by resource class name and field name.
